title: A lumber jack's axe rest upon a tree as he seeks the welcome shade of future soon fallen So a soldier find's quarter in arms of an enemy #poetryport
summary: A lumber jack's axe rest upon a tree as he seeks the welcome shade of future soon fallen So a soldier find's quarter in arms of an enemy #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
A lumber jack's
axe rest upon a tree
as he seeks the
welcome shade
of future soon
fallen
So
a soldier find's quarter
in arms of an enemy
#poetryport
